question: How much CO₂ is avoided by recycling six tons of glass?
answer: Recycling six tons of glass keeps about one ton of CO₂ out of the air. Melting old glass replaces making new glass from raw sand, which is far more carbon-intensive. So every six tons recycled avoids roughly one ton of CO₂ emissions.
move: Six tons of glass recycled ≈ one ton of CO₂ never emitted.
